proves.claim: A spec-approve result carrying applied.commit makes the page message name the short commit id instead of pending apply.

view.approve-apply.commit-named.why: Without it an approval the board already committed would still read as waiting.

proves.claim: A spec-approve result carrying applied.left makes the page message show that one command left.

view.approve-apply.left-named.why: Without it the person is not told the one command that finishes the approval.

proves.claim: A spec-approve result with no applied field keeps the pending apply text.

view.approve-apply.absent-keeps-pending.why: Without it a board with the apply setting off would show a wrong message.
